While the WebSurfer correctly identified Phil Rosen as a "film director and cinematographer," the Planner erroneously added a third role ("photographer") to Rosen's list without any supporting evidence from the search results. The visible text from the WebSurfer explicitly states Rosen was a "cameraman" (silent era) and "cinematographer," but never uses the term "photographer" as a professional credit. By hallucinating this third role, the Planner artificially inflated Rosen's professional scope to claim he had a broader range of professions than Delmer Daves (who was correctly identified as a director, screenwriter, and producer). This contradicts the actual data provided in the previous step and leads to an incorrect conclusion.
